titles.title: Austrian Copper Rose IV

description: Oil on canvas and cardboard. The red petals of an Austrian copper rose glow yellow at the flower's center. A splotch of red marks the exact center of the bloom. Green petals frame the rose, while a reddish-brown stem supports it. A softly shaded pink and cream background surrounds the plant.
title: Austrian Copper Rose IV
